notes.title: Bug and Suggestion Feedback Event for Time-Space Rebuild
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470502/ea0062d6c28813ff1ada9bad9280aa0fb7816af0.jpg[/img]Dear players, the demo version of Time-Space Rebuild is now available on the Steam platform. In order to further optimize the gaming experience and enhance the quality of the game, we have decided to launch this Bug and Suggestion Feedback Event. Every piece of feedback from you is the driving force behind our progress. Let's work together to make Time-Space Rebuild even better!

Event Duration
From now until February 14, 2025

Feedback Format
Steam Email: This will be used to send you your reward.

Hardware Information: Please include the brand and model of your device, system version, network environment, and any other factors that may cause issues.

Language Settings: Please specify the system language settings and the language settings within the game.

Bug Description: Please provide the time of occurrence, the scene where it happened, and the steps to reproduce the issue. The more detailed, the better! Thank you!

Related Screenshots & Videos: Please provide as much detail as possible. Thank you!

How to Participate
Please follow the above format to submit your Bug feedback and send it as a package to the following email address: timespacerebuild@innovationdreamtech.com

Reward Details
After the event ends, we will randomly select 10 lucky players from all participants who submitted feedback. Each selected player will receive a Steam CDK. The redemption method is as follows:
Log in to the Steam client.
Click on the "Games" menu and select "Activate a Product on Steam."
Enter the CDK in the pop-up window, click "Next" and complete the activation process.

Notes
Please ensure that the feedback you provide is genuine and effective. Avoid submitting the same issue multiple times.
After the event ends, we will notify the winning players via private message or announcement. Please keep an eye on the relevant information.
Winning players must redeem their CDK within the specified time. Failure to do so will be considered as forfeiture of the reward.
Thank you once again for your support of Time-Space Rebuild. Let's work together to create an even more wonderful gaming world! We wish you an enjoyable gaming experience!

About Time-Space Rebuild
Time-Space Rebuild is a science fiction game set in a fictional world, with "romance simulation" and "story adventure" as its main focuses. The game is presented in first-person perspective and features full-motion live-action filming, aiming to provide players with the most realistic and immersive gaming experience possible.
